title: lepisorus lewisii
intro: Lepisorus lewisii, commonly known as the Lewis's Cliff Brake, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues, due to its therapeutic actions of expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Lepisorus lewisii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties. Research suggests that the plant's bioactive compounds may have potential therapeutic applications, although further studies are needed to confirm its efficacy and safety.
